component.name: OpenPLC Editor
component.summary: Create and compile IEC 61131-3 programs for OpenPLC

description.p: OpenPLC Editor is an integrated development environment for creating PLC programs using IEC 61131-3 languages, including Ladder Diagram, Function Block Diagram and Structured Text. Create projects, compile programs and connect to OpenPLC runtimes over the network.
This community package uses the official upstream AppImage unmodified. Updates are delivered by Flatpak.
Optional access can be enabled for hardware and existing Arduino libraries:

ul.li: Serial and USB devices: flatpak override --user --device=all com.autonomylogic.openplceditor
Read existing Arduino sketchbook libraries: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/Arduino:ro com.autonomylogic.openplceditor
Undo these overrides: flatpak override --user --reset com.autonomylogic.openplceditor
